Chachamaru"You bloody—MURAMASA!!"
Muramasa"When you took Mido away, this same treatment you gave me, remember, Chachamaru? So. Return gift."
Chachamaru"Abe, defective bloody piece! You think this net is stopping ME? I'll be out in no time!"
Chachamaru"TODAY. Today means TODAY, bhosdike! I am smashing you beyond repair!!"
Muramasa"Forever, no, I don't expect to hold you. But getting out will take you a little time, won't it? That much is enough."
Muramasa"My work here will be finished in no time."
Chachamaru"Sh-shit... BHAI, RUN!!"

Kageaki"For what purpose have you come?"
Muramasa"To bring you back."

Muramasa"He would not stand here watching all that like a spectator. He would fight to stop it."
Muramasa"Even if nothing could come of it, SOMETHING he would try!"
Kageaki"…"
Muramasa"Waiting here for God-wod, whatever this is—if he had time for that, he would have time to act."
Kageaki"Correct. The previous Kageaki Minato would certainly do that."
Kageaki"And what follows from this?"
Muramasa"...What is it you want?"
Kageaki"Known things also you are asking."
Muramasa"…"
Kageaki"To save Hikaru."
Muramasa"How?"
Kageaki"You were listening, were you not? This so-called god, apparently buried underground. Pull it out."
Muramasa"...You are saying this without drinking anything?"
Kageaki"A drunkard's bakwaas. Absolutely."
Kageaki"I don't have much faith in it myself. Or much interest. But Hikaru's condition is beyond human help now. If something beyond human understanding does exist, perhaps that power can heal her."
Kageaki"That possibility only. There my interest begins and ends."
Muramasa"............ Suppose this ridiculous wish of yours comes true—"
Muramasa"And Hikaru Minato turns into a godlike monster. Then what will you do?"
Kageaki"Do...?"
Muramasa"She is the Silver Star, don't you understand?! The whole world could really be destroyed!"
Kageaki"Yes. That is possible."
Kageaki"From my side, no objection."
Muramasa"…!"
Kageaki"Hikaru must live. The rest is not my condition."
Muramasa"……………………"

en.html:
Muramasa"Too straightforward, this..."
Kageaki"?"
Muramasa"No torment, no hesitation. Arre, not even a decision you are making."
Muramasa"There is no... choice in it. Nothing."
Kageaki"What are you trying to say?"
Muramasa"What I said. You are not Kageaki Minato."
Kageaki"Don't be foolish. THIS is Kageaki Minato."
Kageaki"The genuine article. Without any lies or pretending."
Muramasa"............ Yes. Probably. That also is probably not wrong."
Muramasa"But—"
Kageaki"You won't accept me? As you please..."
Kageaki"For being myself, your approval is not a requirement."
Muramasa"Mido..."
Kageaki"Well, then? Your offer I have rejected."
Kageaki"What are you proposing now?"
Muramasa"…………"
Kageaki"Talking has failed, so now comes force. This is the usual procedure."
Kageaki"Except you cannot do anything."
Muramasa"...That is..."
Kageaki"The power, you have."
Kageaki"Mental Interference. The secret art peculiar to the Seshu Muramasa line. You have it also."
Kageaki"But—"

Kageaki"Using it is where you fail!"
Muramasa"…"
Kageaki"That time also, inside the detention center. You could not do it."
Kageaki"Tried to control me, and failed. Imperial commands—what a headache they are!"
Kageaki"The emperor's word weighs so heavily? Yes, yes, naturally... A great relief for me."
Muramasa"…"
Kageaki"Go. If nothing you can do, what is the use of standing here? Once Chachamaru gets loose, she really will crush you..."
Kageaki"Run while you can. Find somewhere to sleep. Five hundred years' experience you have."
Muramasa"…………"
Muramasa"...No. That is not it..."
Kageaki"…?"
Muramasa"I couldn't take control of you... but the imperial command wasn't what stopped me."
Muramasa"I told you then also. All that belongs to the distant past."
Kageaki"What are you saying...?"
Muramasa"...The emperor's command does carry weight. And I do want to reject that arrogance of Grandfather, our founder, and Mother, the Second—invading people's minds to get what they wanted..."
Muramasa"But if that were all, I could have broken free. Why I couldn't do it—why I DIDN'T take control of you then—"
Muramasa"WAS BECAUSE YOUR OWN WILL, I DIDN'T WANT TO TAKE THAT FROM YOU!!"
Kageaki"————"
